notes.title: Isolation Fix 2!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The next fix for Isolation is here! Below is the changelist.

[h1]Changelist:    [/h1]

-Fixed wall issue, now you cannot go through it.

-All capsules now have colliders, in the last fix, only the last level capsules had colliders.

-Office chair now is smaller and also has a collider.

-The pause menu was also changed. The main menu button was removed as it wasn't working. Hopefully I can get a new pause menu which will have a better variety of options.

I am also doing a key giveaway on my main group for Isolation. Check the announcement out on the group to see how to enter the giveaway if you are interested.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Isolation Released!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Isolation has released! In the future I will probably do an update for enemy AI. Isolation's current state should be good. Isolation should also have a 20% launch discount for about one week. Please note that the pause menu within the game to go back to the main menu has a little issue so please don't click that button. This could've only been an issue on my side though. The game is also only for windows, I have tried uploading a Mac version but it didn't work, sorry for the inconvenience caused. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Important: Isolation Delay
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

I apologise for any inconvenience caused, but Isolation has been delayed and is releasing later. I try to minimise the delay of games developed, but when necessary, I do delay it, so when it releases, you get a good experience with the game. The game was delayed because I still need to finish some things off. Enemy AI still needs to be implemented in version 1.4. I plan to have Isolation fully released by the end of January, and do not expect anymore delays. Once again, sorry for the inconvenience.


I plan to have a new trailer up shortly, and the windows system specifications will be updated.


Interactive Gaming Studios
